user.title: House Cleaning
user.description: Tracks cleaning chores by room, each with its own cadence. Add chores afterwards with Add chore; each one takes a name, a room and how often it should be done.

data.starter_set: Start with a set of common chores

data_description.starter_set: Nine whole-house chores (vacuum, mop, dust, bathrooms, sheets, counters, fridge, towels, windows) with sensible cadences. Edit or delete them like any other chore.

abort.single_instance_allowed: House Cleaning is already set up.

init.title: House Cleaning
init.description: How far ahead of its due date a chore is called "due soon".

data_description.soon_days: Days before the due date. 0 turns the window off.

error.invalid_soon_days: Must be a whole number of days from 0 to 14.

add.title: Add a chore
add.description: One job. Give it the room it belongs to and nothing else has to be filed; leave the room empty for a whole-house job.

data_description.interval_days: Days between doings. The chore is due this many days after it was last done.

data_description.area: Changing the room here moves the chore's device; moving the device in the device page is undone on the next reload.

error.invalid_interval: Must be a whole number of days from 1 to 365.

mark_done.name: Mark done
mark_done.description: Records that a chore was done. Leave the date empty for now; give one to backfill. A date in the future is refused.

entity_id.name: Chore
entity_id.description: Any entity of the chore -- its Done button, say.

done_at.name: Date
done_at.description: When it was done. Empty means now.

undo.name: Undo
undo.description: Removes the chore's most recent completion -- a mis-tap.

set_interval.name: Set cadence
set_interval.description: Changes how often a chore should be done. A value that is not a whole number of days from 1 to 365 is refused rather than rounded.

not_a_chore.message: {entity_id} is not a House Cleaning chore, or the integration is not loaded. Nothing was changed.

unknown_value.message: {field} is not a value House Cleaning accepts: {value}. Nothing was changed.

nothing_to_undo.message: {name} has no recorded completion to undo.

item_not_found.message: {item} is not a chore on this list. Nothing was changed.

due_is_derived.message: The due date of {name} is its last completion plus its cadence and cannot be set directly. Change the cadence with house_cleaning.set_interval, or record when it was done with house_cleaning.mark_done. Nothing was changed.

description_is_derived.message: The description of {name} is generated from its room, cadence and last completion and cannot be edited. Nothing was changed.
